# Nihal Maskey

> Lead software engineer in Kathmandu, Nepal. Leads health-tech engineering at Leapfrog Technology and co-founded Daboo Spaces.

Nihal is lead engineer at Leapfrog Technology, where his team builds a US health-tech platform. He joined Leapfrog as an intern in 2020 and has led engineering teams there since 2021. He owns the platform's architecture and the security and compliance work that comes with sensitive health data. He leads across the US, Australia and Nepal.

He co-founded Daboo Spaces, a coworking space in Sankhamul, Kathmandu. He studied computer engineering at Kantipur Engineering College, Tribhuvan University (2021).

- Location: Kathmandu, Nepal (UTC+5:45)
- Focus: health tech, cloud architecture, engineering leadership
- Open to: consulting, mentorship, speaking
- Contact: contact@nihal.com.np

## Projects

Products and tools:

- [tz converter](https://tz.nihal.com.np/): browser extension that converts times on a page between time zones (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Firefox)
- [sprintnudge](https://sprintnudge.com/): retrospective board for software teams that he and his team built, with anonymous cards, voting and follow-up of action items
- [underhood](https://underhood.nihal.com.np/): installable web app that tracks service, fuel, expenses and reminders for every vehicle you own
- [space hog](https://github.com/maskeynihal/space-hog): desktop app, in Rust, that shows what is using disk space

Hardware and games:

- [car sensors](https://maskeynihal.github.io/sensor-for-cars/): Arduino UNO R4 WiFi firmware for water and air temperature sensors ([source](https://github.com/maskeynihal/sensor-for-cars))
- [pac-man](https://maskeynihal.github.io/pacman/): browser game in JavaScript and canvas, built during his Leapfrog internship

## Open source

My own public projects (one per repo):

- [maskeynihal/tz-extension](https://github.com/maskeynihal/tz-extension): browser extension that converts times on a page between time zones
- [maskeynihal/space-hog](https://github.com/maskeynihal/space-hog): Rust desktop app that finds what is filling your disk
- [maskeynihal/sensor-for-cars](https://github.com/maskeynihal/sensor-for-cars): Arduino firmware for car sensors, testable in an emulator
- [maskeynihal/large-json-diff](https://github.com/maskeynihal/large-json-diff): compares two large JSON files
- [maskeynihal/nihal.com.np](https://github.com/maskeynihal/nihal.com.np): this site, in Astro and TypeScript
- [maskeynihal/effortless](https://github.com/maskeynihal/effortless): CLI that provisions a server and deploys a Laravel app
- [maskeynihal/group-continuous-dates](https://github.com/maskeynihal/group-continuous-dates): npm package that groups continuous dates
- [maskeynihal/pursue](https://github.com/maskeynihal/pursue): event and job handling on AWS SQS
- [maskeynihal/mailer](https://github.com/maskeynihal/mailer): a small Mail class for sending email

Contributions to other repos (one per repo):

- [digitalocean/nginxconfig.io](https://github.com/digitalocean/nginxconfig.io/commits?author=maskeynihal): independent scrolling in split-column mode (#433); prettier via lint-staged (#448)
- [spatie/holidays](https://github.com/spatie/holidays/pull/247): Nepal holiday calendar, with tests
- [kritish-dhaubanjar/dynamodb-dashboard](https://github.com/kritish-dhaubanjar/dynamodb-dashboard/commits?author=maskeynihal): 18 commits
- [kritish-dhaubanjar/dev-auth-chrome-extension](https://github.com/kritish-dhaubanjar/dev-auth-chrome-extension/commits?author=maskeynihal): Svelte rewrite, add-user form, token handling
- [benawad/dogehouse](https://github.com/benawad/dogehouse/commits?author=maskeynihal): Nepali translation
- [supabase/supabase](https://github.com/supabase/supabase/commits?author=maskeynihal): null-check fix; docs
